response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, CAST(`T-BIL` AS REAL) / CRE AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), grouped AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM grouped) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Laboratory.Date is stored as ISO text (YYYY-MM-DD), so the string range comparison matches the requested dates. The field documentation says YYMMDD, which would break this comparison; the request says to compare the text as stored, so I did not convert it.
A missing status means CENTROMEA IS NULL. Empty strings are treated as a separate status value, not as missing.
Each row's ratio is T-BIL / CRE and is NULL when either input is NULL or CRE is 0 (SQLite returns NULL on division by zero), so such rows drop out of the ratio average.
The plain mean is AVG over the per-status average ratios, skipping any status whose average ratio is NULL. If that mean is NULL, no rows are returned.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is taken from the group averages: average T-BIL divided by average CRE within each status, rather than the average of per-row ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL`) / AVG(CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM grouped) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;

alternatives.interpretation: Empty or whitespace-only CENTROMEA values count as missing and join the missing-status group with NULLs.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CENTROMEA), '') AS status, HGB, CAST(`T-BIL` AS REAL) / CRE AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), grouped AS (SELECT status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered GROUP BY status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM grouped) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;
